professionalSummary.text: Released ranking models to the production search service under a traffic ramp and read the live relevance and conversion dashboards after each release.
professionalSummary.witness: Released five ranking models to the production search service of the marketplace between 2023 and 2025, each under a traffic ramp from one per cent to full traffic and each on a release ticket in my name. Read the live relevance and conversion dashboards after every release and in the weekly ranking review, and rolled one release back in 2024 when the conversion dashboard showed a regression on low-traffic categories.
